adjudication.rationale: In `basePath(store, type)`, the diff changes the admin model check to `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace('_','-')` only replaces the first underscore, so a type like `foo_bar_baz` would become `foo-bar_baz` and would not match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry written as `foo-bar-baz`. The diff doesn’t show any current `ADMIN_MODELS` entries (or types used here) that contain multiple underscores (e.g. `site_customization` and `embeddable_host` each have only one), so it’s an edge-case/incompleteness rather than a demonstrable breakage in this PR.
